release_notes: Pulse Glass 141 (rp-mtnzjxi3-kkbrk) is registered as an experimental moor.render/1 Lean Custom WebGL2 challenger for moor.city.island.
The challenger renders on a separate WebGL2 canvas while the Legacy Three renderer object remains alive for current gameplay/input plumbing and instant rollback.
Renderer Pulls RUN now measures Pulse Glass only on the actual City Island runtime; no performance score is prefilled or claimed by this release.

Telemetry includes frame p95/p99, renderer CPU p95, draw calls, triangles, resource/upload bytes, errors, scene coverage, unsupported-object count, and the mandatory moor.render telemetry fields where measurable; unavailable GPU timing is explicitly UNAVAILABLE.
RenderReplay delegates to the City replay service when present and reports unsupported when that service is absent.

Pulse Glass v0.1.2 does not yet fully implement textures, shadows, Sprite/LOD, BatchedMesh, transparent or multi-material fidelity, or fog; coverage penalties cap its live score rather than hiding missing presentation features.
Running any different renderer pull first stops Pulse Glass and restores the Legacy Three draw path before the next candidate starts.
32.1.2 supersedes transient 32.1.0 and 32.1.1 and publishes byte-verified immutable Pulse Glass modules.
